_note: Racial-grip finisher textures from make_grip_sprites.py (offline numpy render). White art is tinted in Roblox via Color; 'baked' entries carry their own RGB and should use Color white. Fill in the ids after upload.

grip_priest_runes.purpose: Priest finisher: holy seal circle on the floor (rings, invented liturgical glyph band, cross-shaped star, filigree).
grip_priest_runes.usage: Decal (Face Top) or SurfaceGui ImageLabel on a thin flat part under the target; tint via Color3; spin slowly; tween Transparency in/out.

grip_lifethread_v.purpose: Life-drain thread: braided luminous strands + soft core between grabber and victim.
grip_lifethread_v.usage: Beam.Texture, TextureMode Wrap (or Stretch), TextureLength 4-8, TextureSpeed 1-2, LightEmission 1, Width 0.4-1.2, Color tint; tiles along the beam, alpha 0 at both sides.

grip_ink_smoke_4x4.purpose: Boiling black ink-smoke puff that billows and dissolves (16 frames).
grip_ink_smoke_4x4.usage: ParticleEmitter FlipbookLayout Grid4x4, FlipbookMode OneShot, Lifetime 0.8-1.4, Color white (art is baked dark), LightEmission 0, LightInfluence 0-0.3, Size 2-6, Rotation random.

grip_ink_tendril_v.purpose: Clawing dark ink tendril with hooked thorns and smoke wisps.
grip_ink_tendril_v.usage: Beam.Texture, TextureMode Wrap, TextureLength 3-6, TextureSpeed 0.5-1.5, Color white (baked dark), LightEmission 0, Width 0.8-2, CurveSize0/1 for a reaching arc; alpha 0 at both sides.

grip_claw_slash.purpose: Werewolf finisher: three curved claw-rake slash smears (hot core, glow, motion smear).
grip_claw_slash.usage: ParticleEmitter single burst (Rate 0, Emit 1), Lifetime 0.2-0.35, Size 5-9 shrinking/stretching, LightEmission 1, Orientation FacingCamera or VelocityPerpendicular; or a BillboardGui ImageLabel tweened.

grip_slash_spark_2x2.purpose: Silver impact spark/flare popping and fading (4 frames).
grip_slash_spark_2x2.usage: ParticleEmitter FlipbookLayout Grid2x2, FlipbookMode OneShot, Lifetime 0.15-0.3, Emit 1-3, Size 2-4, LightEmission 1, random Rotation.

grip_frost_floor.purpose: Wraith finisher: circular frost bloom with branching ice dendrites, seen from above.
grip_frost_floor.usage: Decal (Face Top) on a thin flat part, grow by tweening the part Size from 0.2x to 1x, then fade Transparency; Color tint.

grip_grave_cracks.purpose: Ghoul finisher: radial cracked-stone fracture decal.
grip_grave_cracks.usage: Decal (Face Top) on a thin flat part, Color white (baked dark); stack grip_grave_cracks_glow on a second decal just above it.

grip_grave_cracks_glow.purpose: Glow channels inside the grave cracks (white mask, same layout as grip_grave_cracks).
grip_grave_cracks_glow.usage: Second Decal on a part 0.01 stud above the cracks decal, Color #8FBF6A, pulse Transparency 0.2-0.6; same size and position as the cracks.

grip_ash_4x4.purpose: Ash flake cluster crumbling apart into drifting flecks (16 frames).
grip_ash_4x4.usage: ParticleEmitter FlipbookLayout Grid4x4, FlipbookMode OneShot, Lifetime 1-2, Size 1-3, Acceleration slightly up, LightEmission 0, Color tint.

grip_gold_dust_2x2.purpose: Twinkling holy motes with tiny 4-point star glints (4 looping frames).
grip_gold_dust_2x2.usage: ParticleEmitter FlipbookLayout Grid2x2, FlipbookMode Loop, FlipbookFramerate 6-10, Lifetime 1-2, Size 1.5-3, LightEmission 1, Color tint.

grip_soul_streak_v.purpose: Spectral spiralling soul streak with abstract ghostly smears.
grip_soul_streak_v.usage: Beam.Texture, TextureMode Wrap, TextureLength 6-10, TextureSpeed 1.5-3, LightEmission 1, Width 1-2.5, Color tint; alpha 0 at both sides.

grip_shockwave.purpose: Soft dust/air shockwave ring (thick leading edge, wispy trailing inside) for an expanding ground ring.
grip_shockwave.usage: Decal (Face Top) on a thin flat part; tween Size up 4-6x over 0.4-0.7 s (Quint Out) while Transparency goes 0.2 -> 1.

grip_moon_halo.purpose: Pale full moon disc with soft craters, a halo and faint radiating rays.
grip_moon_halo.usage: BillboardGui ImageLabel or ParticleEmitter (Emit 1, long Lifetime), Color white (baked), LightEmission 0.3-1; fade in behind the finisher.

grip_demon_shape.purpose: Abstract shadow-demon silhouette (horned smoky head, clawed reaching arms) torn upward, dissolving into smoke.
grip_demon_shape.usage: ParticleEmitter (Emit 1, Lifetime 0.8-1.5, Size 8-14 growing, Acceleration up, Transparency 1 -> 0.1 -> 1) or a BillboardGui ImageLabel; Color white (baked dark), LightEmission 0.
